info.name: Transform rows with a deployed application

params.name: applicationName
params.description: The name of the deployed application (for example, resume-parsing).

items.docs: Submit a JSON array of input rows to a deployed application to run LLM labeling / prediction in realtime. Each row is an object whose keys match the application's expected input fields. The application applies its Task guidelines and returns the transformed (labeled / enriched) output for each row. Subject to a documented rate limit of 300 requests per minute and up to 100 concurrent requests.
